description: Returns the edit link of a document in the ReflowPDF editor, where the person edits it on the page and downloads it: your HTML, or a template with its data (kept as template and data, both editable). Use when the person wants to change the document themselves; you can read their changes and change it too (get_document, update_document).

data.description: The values of the template, if it is one.

html.description: The HTML document (or your own template source, with data).

name.description: The document's name in the editor.

template_id.description: A gallery template's id, instead of html.

name: open_in_editor
title: Open in the ReflowPDF editor
